ValidationRule.description: Right Party Contact must be indicated when the Case Status is Sent to Accounting. Applies to Bounce cases only. Not applicable to Lease Opportunities. Lease Opportunity Record Type = 01280000000BZvi
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ACH_Bounce', NOT(Opportunity__r.RecordTypeId='01280000000BZvi'), ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status,'Sent to Accounting'), ISBLANK(TEXT(RPC__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: RPC must be indicated before the Case can be Sent to Accounting.
